body.message:
Apologies for the delay, and thank you for your patience.

Please note that for a 1-year stay, we do not offer annual contracts or Ejari. However, you are welcome to stay long-term by extending the booking on a monthly basis, subject to availability.

Regarding the rates, our minimum monthly rates start from AED 9,000 and above. Unfortunately, we do not currently have any apartments available below this rate.

Thank you for your understanding, and we would be happy to assist you with the available options.
